title: A Quiet Day Spent Alone - Inspiration for Simple Living - Cozy Baking Vlog
en: it's quite normal for me to spend a day by myself where i don't encounter another person i want to share a little insight into that day with you and at the end of this video let's have a sit down chat so stay tuned and we'll talk some more so

wax currants are not a popular berries since they barely have any flavor but they have very high pectin content and so it's quite easy to mix them with another berry and make jams or jellies and preserves i was once told that native american peoples would eat these berries as a source of nutrition in times of hardship but i can't be sure that that is true so
do i have only a handful of highly

meaningful relationships in my life and it is by choice and i do spend a lot of time alone my hobbies include painting and reading and puttering about outdoors and so i can easily go an entire day without seeing another human i do have a very loving and supportive family and partner who i regularly spend time with but i always make sure to keep time for myself and to listen to my spirit and what my introverted needs are i also have a menagerie of pets with quite obnoxious personalities that keep me highly entertained from the perspective of many people i

live quite an isolated lifestyle which is so interesting to me to think about since i feel like i live a life of such abundance and isolation is often connected to a scarcity but it is true i i do live in a very rural area and i travel much less than i ever have before yet i do find myself extremely happy probably the happiest i've been since i was a child now i don't wish to sell this lifestyle as an ideal i i definitely don't think it is appropriate for every spirit i don't believe there's one lifestyle or even belief system that applies to everyone coming to live here was not easy at first um i had to rewrite the

thesis of my entire life in order to be happy here and it was a challenge that i'm so thankful i persevered through i had to let go of what i perceived to be success i was a very competitive university student and i was addicted to the pursuit of wealth and i connected wealth to freedom to live how i wanted and the irony of it was that neither was i making much money even though i was working hard but i was also not living my dream and consequently i was constantly living in the future day-to-day life felt like a strange meaningless cycle in which there was no

end after moving here it took quite a long time to pull myself out of the haze and to really open my eyes and appreciate the wonder and beauty of where i lived it was a process of coming home to my inner spirit and i'm so happy now to say that i can more easily relate to my five-year-old self than my 19 year old self and in my personal story that's a very good thing all this being said i'm just sitting here telling you a tiny part of my individual story i hope that through these videos i might be able to contribute a little bit of insight into another lifestyle and another pace of living that may align with yours

or inspire you if anything i want to share my passion for growing a sense of abundance through simple living i have found my truth by learning how to silence my mind and listen to my inner spirit it's an ongoing process and i am no master of it but i keep trying and i think that's all we need to expect of ourselves to do i hope that today you might be inspired to take a moment and to go into the quiet and to listen to your soul and ask it what it needs and also ask the people in your life what they need and learn how to find a balance between sharing and loving and
loving yourself subscribe if you want to see videos every wednesday um in the meantime have a wonderful day hugs and kisses to everyone bye
zh: 对我来说，独自度过一天是很正常的，我不会遇到另一个人，我想与您分享这一天的一些见解，在本视频的最后，让我们坐下来聊聊，所以请继续关注，我们会再聊一些
蜡醋栗不是一种受欢迎的浆果，因为它们几乎没有任何味道，但果胶含量非常高，因此很容易将它们与另一种浆果混合并制作果酱或果冻和蜜饯。我曾经被告知美洲原住民会在困难时期吃这些浆果作为营养来源，但我不能确定这是真的，所以
我的生活中有意义的人际关系是我的选择，我确实花了很多时间独处，我的爱好包括绘画、阅读和在户外闲逛，所以我可以很容易地一整天都见不到另一个人。很多人我
过着一种与世隔绝的生活方式，这对我来说很有趣，因为我觉得我过着如此丰富的生活，而与世隔绝往往与匮乏联系在一起，但这是事实，我确实住在一个非常农村地区，我的旅行比以前少得多，但我确实发现自己非常幸福，可能是我从小以来最幸福的，现在我不想把这种生活方式作为一种理想来出售，我绝对不认为它适合每一种精神，我不相信有一种生活方式甚至信仰适用于每个来这里住的人的系统一开始并不容易，嗯我不得不重写
为了在这里快乐，这是我一生的主题，这是一个挑战，我非常感激，我坚持了下来，我必须放弃我认为的成功，我是一个非常有竞争力的大学生，我沉迷于追求财富，我将财富与自由联系起来，按照我想要的方式生活，讽刺的是，即使我努力工作，我也没有赚到多少钱，但我也没有实现我的梦想，因此我不断地生活在未来的日常生活中，感觉就像一个奇怪的人无意义的循环，其中没有
搬到这里后，我花了很长时间才把自己从阴霾中拉出来，真正睁开眼睛，欣赏我所居住的地方的奇迹和美丽，这是一个回归内心精神的过程，我现在很高兴地说，我可以比19岁的自己更容易地与五岁的自己产生共鸣，在我个人的故事中，这是一件非常好的事情，我只是坐在这里告诉你我个人故事的一小部分，我希望通过这些视频我能够为另一种生活方式和另一种生活节奏提供一些可能与您相符的见解
或者激励你，如果有什么我想分享我对通过简单的生活培养丰富感的热情，我通过学习如何让自己的思想安静下来，倾听我内在的精神，找到了我的真理，这是一个持续的过程，我不是它的主人，但我不断努力，我认为这就是我们需要对自己做的一切，我希望今天你可能会受到启发，花点时间进入安静，倾听你的灵魂，问它需要什么，也问你生活中的人他们需要什么，学习如何找到一个合适的人。分享与爱之间的平衡
爱你自己，如果你想每个星期三看视频，请订阅，同时祝你有美好的一天，拥抱和亲吻每个人，再见
